hero.title: Your money.
hero.subtitle: Every currency.
hero.text: Orion Bank is a demo multi-currency wallet for fiat and crypto. It is a fictional product, not a real bank or financial service.

about.title: About Orion <gradient>Bank</gradient>
about.subtitle: One account, multiple currencies
about.text: A universal web application for secure transfers and asset exchange.

convenience.label: Convenience
convenience.title: Banking without limits
convenience.text: Open up to three cards of every currency type to meet your needs and preferences. Apply for credit, make transfers and withdraw cryptocurrency — all in one bank. Our multifunctional cards and wide range of financial services let you manage your funds easily and effectively.

cryptoTopUp.label: Crypto Top-Up
cryptoTopUp.title: Seamless crypto integration
cryptoTopUp.text: Fund your fiat accounts with cryptocurrency instantly. Our platform supports BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, and XDUSDT — with automatic conversion at live market rates. No middlemen, no delays.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.title: Available 24/7, anywhere
accessibility.text: Access your accounts from any device, at any time, from any country. Our platform is fully optimised for mobile and desktop with enterprise-grade availability guarantees.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Everything in one platform
services.text: Built for individuals and businesses who demand more from their bank.

multiCurrency.title: Multi-Currency Accounts
multiCurrency.text: Hold EUR, USD, GBP, CHF and manage BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, XDUSDT — all in one secure account.

instantTransfers.title: Instant Transfers
instantTransfers.text: SEPA, Wire, and crypto transfers processed in real-time with live status tracking.

security.title: Bank-Grade Security
security.text: Military-grade encryption, multi-factor authentication, and full KYC/AML compliance.

cards.title: Virtual & Physical Cards
cards.text: Instantly issued virtual Visa card plus a premium metal physical card delivered worldwide.

liveRates.title: Live Crypto Rates
liveRates.text: Real-time cryptocurrency prices updated every minute across all your portfolio assets.

compliance.title: Full Compliance
compliance.text: Operating under strict European regulatory standards with verified KYC procedures.

partners.title: Partners
partners.subtitle: Orion Bank operates in partnership with leading European and American financial institutions, ensuring the highest level of reliability and liquidity.

license.title: License & Regulation
license.subtitle: Orion Bank operates under strict regulatory oversight, ensuring the safety and security of your assets.

banking.title: Banking License
banking.text: Operating license information will be published here shortly. We are committed to full regulatory transparency.

amlKyc.title: AML/KYC Compliance
amlKyc.text: Full Anti-Money Laundering and Know Your Customer procedures are in place, verified by independent auditors.

clientProtection.title: Client Protection
clientProtection.text: Client funds are held in segregated accounts at partner institutions, ensuring full protection of your assets.

license.disclaimer: Demo only: Orion Bank holds no licences and is not regulated by any authority.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Contact our support team for assistance with your account or transactions.

chat.title: Live chat
chat.text: Chat with our support team in real-time for immediate assistance.

email.title: Email
email.text: Reach out to us via email and we will respond within 24 hours.

help.title: Help center
help.text: Browse our help center for answers to common questions and detailed guides on using our platform.

currencies.question: What currencies are supported?
currencies.answer: We support EUR, USD, GBP, and CHF for fiat accounts, as well as BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, and XDUSDT for crypto accounts.

kyc.question: How long does KYC verification take?
kyc.answer: Our team reviews submitted documents within 1–3 business days. You will be notified once the process is complete.

insurance.question: Are my funds insured?
insurance.answer: This is a demo environment and no real funds are held. Please contact our support team for details on deposit protection.

transfers.question: What transfer methods are available?
transfers.answer: We support SEPA (EU/EEA), international Wire transfers, crypto wallet transfers, and direct card-to-card transfers.

card.question: How do I order a physical card?
card.answer: Log in to your account, navigate to the dashboard, and click "Order Physical Card". A one-time fee of 50 USDT applies. Delivery takes 14 business days.

contact.title: Contact title
contact.sent: Message sent (demo — nothing leaves your browser).

footer.tagline: A new generation banking platform for fiat and cryptocurrency asset management.
footer.disclaimer: Orion Bank is a fictional demo. It does not provide financial services, process payments or store personal data.
